derivation: git log --diff-filter=A -1 -- <every input of the replay>: the newest commit that added any of them. A replay needs a tree holding ALL its inputs, so the pin is the max, and each add-commit is AT OR AFTER the run that produced that input.
note: Re-checking runs the declared revision against these manifests UNCHANGED. The manifests are the blind author's output and are never edited to suit a later tool.
step_note: The blind re-extraction arm — 54 facts read back out of the rendered manuscript. It reuses the game's section ids (its facts cite sc-01-long-climb onward) because the extractor was given the world's coordinate vocabulary, not a fresh one. reextracted.facts.json holds the same 54 facts with no registries: it is the agent's raw output, superseded by the manifest, and is fed by no replay. This whole arm was invisible to the R882 census, which recognised an input by its filename.
